verdict.rationale: Channel3 is a product-data API, not an agent, so the MCP-server axis applies, and it documents an official MCP server. The MCP overview names supported clients (Cursor, VS Code, Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, OpenCode), a dedicated MCP shopping-agent use case says it works without code or an API key, and a probe confirmed the official MCP docs page and its listing in llms.txt. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working in practice, details on the tool surface exposed via MCP.
